function.name: calculate_electric_field
function.description: Calculate the electric field produced by a charge at a certain distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge.description: Charge in coulombs producing the electric field.

distance.description: Distance from the charge in meters where the field is being measured.

permitivity.description: Permitivity of the space where field is being calculated, default is 8.854e-12. This is a float type value.
